designs.label: 热点发现 · 从话题找到创作机会
designs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity Chinese Content Studio desktop application. The supplied image is APPROVED visual/shell reference only. Preserve warm ivory center, sand side panes, forest-green actions, restrained terracotta active highlights, hairline separators, Chinese serif headings and sans-serif controls. Flat full landscape 16:10 edge-to-edge screenshot; no device/browser/scenery or callout labels. Three panes left library 18%, center work 52%, right persistent Agent chat 30%. No fourth sidebar.
APP NAV UPDATE: left brand Content Studio, green + 新建内容, search, global nav "热点" SELECTED with a small flame/trend outline icon and pale terracotta background, then "素材库", then 内容库 and existing projects 让灵感成为作品 / 我的阅读笔记 / 碎片时间，持续创作 / 城市漫游手记. None of those projects selected, since browsing hotspots globally before creating content. Bottom 设置. Right header 创作 Agent, 当前会话 dropdown and plus. Bottom composer and context.
IMPORTANT all topic items, summaries, badges and sources are FICTIONAL UI SAMPLE DATA. Include a small visible "设计示例 · 非实时热点" badge in center header. Do not fabricate real breaking news, actual ranking numbers, official platform API integrations, live trending counts, popularity scores or real current timestamps. Use topic illustrations as needed but no hero photo.
Screen 1 global HOTSPOT DISCOVERY feed. Center header "从热点，找到你的表达" with small subtitle "先看话题和来源，再决定值得写什么。" To right small secondary 收藏 and icon refresh "刷新". Visible small 设计示例 · 非实时热点 badge.
Compact search "搜索热点或关键词…". Topic-category tabs "综合" SELECTED / "AI 科技" / "职场" / "生活" / "文化". Second toolbar source dropdown "全部来源" and time dropdown "近 24 小时" and sort "热度 / 最新" with 最新 selected. No abstract global heat score shared across platforms.
Single-column four tidy topical cards with generous readable typography:
1 selected subtle green border title "AI 工具能帮普通人持续创作吗？". Metadata "AI 科技 · 知乎、小红书 · 示例聚合". One-line context "围绕工具选择、创作习惯和个人表达的讨论。" Small tags 个人创作 / 工具与方法. A quiet recommendation rationale "适合你的方向：创作方法" (not numerical match percentage). Clear forest-green button "查看与创作", secondary bookmark icon 收藏.
2 title "越来越多人用纸质笔记找回专注". Metadata 生活 · 小红书 · 示例聚合. Context "可以从记录习惯与注意力管理切入。". Quiet 查看与创作 action.
3 title "通勤时间，怎样变成自己的时间". Metadata 职场 · 知乎、X · 示例聚合. Context "从具体生活场景讲述时间分配。". Small 已创作 1 篇 badge with link 查看已有内容, plus 查看与创作, allowing new angles.
4 title "普通人的小作品，为什么值得被看见". Metadata 文化 · 公众号 · 示例聚合. Context "讨论表达、分享与创作者的起点。". Quiet 查看与创作.
Cards no sensational flames or red hot score; instead inspectable source metadata. Bottom quiet "同一话题的多个来源会合并展示。" These sources are fictional examples, not API connection guarantees.
RIGHT user "帮我从这些话题里找一个适合聊创作方法的。". Assistant "可以先看『AI 工具与持续创作』这个话题。它能连接你关心的记录习惯、创作流程和个人表达。先查看来源，再选一个你有经验的角度。". A small topic reference card "AI 工具能帮普通人持续创作吗？" / "热点解读 · 待选角度". No automatic article generation. Composer context 当前热点：AI 工具与个人创作 ×, placeholder "这个话题还有哪些切入角度？".
Constraints: same warm editorial app. Feed is browsing, bookmark keeps topic for later, CTA opens topic detail and angle selection before new content. No auto-publish, no required keyword form or autonomous trend monitor.

designs.label: 热点解读 · 选角度并发起创作
designs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity Chinese Content Studio desktop application. The supplied image is APPROVED visual/shell reference only. Preserve warm ivory center, sand side panes, forest-green actions, restrained terracotta active highlights, hairline separators, Chinese serif headings and sans-serif controls. Flat full landscape 16:10 edge-to-edge screenshot; no device/browser/scenery or callout labels. Three panes left library 18%, center work 52%, right persistent Agent chat 30%. No fourth sidebar.
APP NAV UPDATE: left brand Content Studio, green + 新建内容, search, global nav "热点" SELECTED with a small flame/trend outline icon and pale terracotta background, then "素材库", then 内容库 and existing projects 让灵感成为作品 / 我的阅读笔记 / 碎片时间，持续创作 / 城市漫游手记. None of those projects selected, since browsing hotspots globally before creating content. Bottom 设置. Right header 创作 Agent, 当前会话 dropdown and plus. Bottom composer and context.
IMPORTANT all topic items, summaries, badges and sources are FICTIONAL UI SAMPLE DATA. Include a small visible "设计示例 · 非实时热点" badge in center header. Do not fabricate real breaking news, actual ranking numbers, official platform API integrations, live trending counts, popularity scores or real current timestamps. Use topic illustrations as needed but no hero photo.
Screen 2 SELECT ANGLE AND START CONTENT from a hotspot. Center back link ← 返回热点. Heading "AI 工具与个人创作" serif, metadata "AI 科技 · 示例聚合 · 2 条来源", visible badge 设计示例 · 非实时热点. Small bookmark 已收藏.
Small section "话题概览" with ONE short pale neutral paragraph "示例讨论围绕三个问题：如何选择工具、怎样坚持创作，以及如何保留自己的表达。". Tiny label "AI 整理 · 结合所选来源" (distinguish synthesis from original source).
Next "参考来源" and "已选 2 条". Two compact source rows with CHECKED checkboxes, clear title and source labels, text link 查看原文:
1 "一位创作者的工具使用记录" / "知乎 · 示例来源"
2 "从随手记录到一篇作品" / "小红书 · 示例来源"
No real URLs or quoted external statements, fictional design sources. Metadata source fields reserved for real publication/collection time in actual product, no invented exact dates.
Next section "你想从哪个角度写？". Three single-choice radio angle rows:
A SELECTED forest-green radio / "普通人需要的，是更多工具还是更顺手的流程？" / small helper "方法与经验 · 适合长文或口播"
B unselected / "先养成记录习惯，再谈 AI 提效" / helper "个人经历 · 适合图文分享"
C unselected / "工具负责整理，观点仍要自己形成" / helper "观点表达 · 适合回答或串文"
Next small EDITABLE field "我的切入点" actual value "结合自己的碎片记录习惯，聊聊怎样让工具服务表达。". Quiet helper "也可以直接改写角度，或让 Agent 继续调整。"
Center sticky footer text "将新建内容，并带入所选角度与 2 条来源。" ONE forest-green primary "用这个角度开始创作". This action creates a fresh content project and drafts a CREATIVE PLAN for human review; it must not immediately render final article/publish. No mandatory platform selector, platform variants chosen later. No existing project overwritten.
RIGHT user "想讲具体做法，不想只推荐一堆工具。". Assistant "可以从『流程比工具更重要』切入。把你实际怎样记录、整理和表达写清楚，会比罗列工具更有个人观点。我已把几个角度放在中间，你可以直接调整。". One small scope card "开始后会带入" / "热点背景 · 选中角度 · 所选来源". Tiny note "下一步先确认创作方案。". Composer context 当前热点：AI 工具与个人创作 ×, placeholder "帮我把这个角度再收窄一点…".
Constraints: all content fictional demonstrative, inspectable source rows separate from AI angle suggestions. Same topic reusable for multiple independent content projects. Explicit start action is sole primary CTA, no duplicate create button in chat, no automatic sending/publishing. Maintain all relevant source and angle controls visibly within center.
